summary: IPv4 fixes exactly four segments of at most three digits, so the complete search tree has a constant maximum size independent of the legal input-length cap. A bounded-work proof verifies the required O(1) bound.

replacement_checks.evidence: The recursion has depth four and tries at most three segment lengths per level, for at most 1 + 3 + 3^2 + 3^3 + 3^4 states. Every slice, integer parse, and final join handles at most the constant IPv4 address length; strings outside 4 through 12 digits are rejected at the root.

The source-fidelity-verified examples cover maximum-value segments, all-zero segments, and several valid boundary layouts; black-box real-test execution verifies all existing ordinary checks without inspecting their definitions.
